about: Night Market's gate (night-market-remaster RM9, art/grid/round-68-night-market-gate): Hunyuan3D 2.1 from ref-gate.jpg (r7's three-bay gate), picked over TRELLIS.2 at the shipped budget (TRELLIS's gold trim and plinths went dark in the 15k re-bake).
